rules.check_text: Expected: every UVM monitor throws a uvm_error immediately upon sampling X or Z on any sampled control or data signal, and DUT outputs reach known (non-X/Z) values after reset deassertion; dedicated simulator X-propagation runs complement but never replace these monitor checks.
rules.rationale: Unknown-value propagation hides reset, connectivity, and uninitialized-register bugs; failing fast in the monitor catches them at the sampling source instead of debugging downstream mismatches.
rules.statement: UVM monitors must throw a uvm_error immediately upon sampling X or Z on any sampled control or data signal, and DUT outputs must reach known (non-X/Z) values after reset deassertion. Dedicated simulator X-propagation runs complement but never replace these monitor checks.
